name: @trajectonomics/guards
description: Repository guards that run in `bun run check`: links to archived repositories, a notice for every vendored upstream skill, ADR numbers that are unique within a directory, and no static site keeping its own copy of the shared header frame. They read every tracked file, so `turbo.json` here keeps turbo from caching them.

scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test
